page.overview:
Who is Crusher?

The slaughterbrute Crusher was slaved to the will of Adroch -- one of the surviving Azure Princes, the apprentice sorcerers of Vilitch the Curseling. Adroch had secretly been training the brute to be resistant to all manner of magic, with the intent of employing Crusher as his method of usurping Vilitch and taking command of the siege. What Adroch didn't know was that Vilitch had spells of command buried even deeper in Crusher's tiny mind. At the first hint of rebellion, Crusher would have pulverised Adroch, and all who stood with him.
